candidate_relation_semantics: An exact source-native predicate/target is positively supported within one exact empirical scope/risk-set; commits only the actor-independent support-within-scope relation, not social interpretation
order_cardinality: ROLE_LABELED_NO_METRIC_ORDER;2 participants;fact ref is evidence not new owner
minimum_empirical_premises: One exact producer-owned EmpiricalFact@1.0.0 in SUPPORTED state; exact EmpiricalQuerySpec; exact universe/scope/risk-set; n>0; d>0; exact measure basis and replay
joint_information_requirement: NONE_BEYOND_WHATEVER_THE_PRODUCER_QUERY_ALREADY_LAWFULLY_EXECUTED; strongest advantage when the empirical claim is unary
core_falsifiers: Producer fact not SUPPORTED; n<=0 or d<=0 for positive relation; query/fact/hash mismatch; scope/risk-set mismatch; participant substitution; permission widening; replay divergence; relation is only a renamed EmpiricalFact with no distinct relation commitment
information_loss: PREFER_NONE__REFERENCE_PRESERVING with exact upstream fact/query/authority/replay refs retained
replay_minimum: Relation rule identity/version/hash + fact ref/hash + query ref + universe/scope/risk-set + numerator/denominator + measure basis + provenance + producer replay ref + relation replay receipt
avoided_authorities: No cross-context transport; no geometry; no PRA; no strong noun; no V553/V555/V556; no new weight/estimand if upstream claim is already lawful
conditional_recommendation: FIRST_CHOICE_ONLY_IF_SEMANTIC_NOVELTY_GATE_PASSES; otherwise do not create a courier/relabel object

candidate_relation_semantics: Two or more exact predicates/states co-occur on the same empirical unit within one exact risk-set; commits conjunction/joint relation identity and support without mechanism or actor meaning
order_cardinality: MEMBER_SET_CANONICAL_HASH_ORDER unless source/claim makes order semantic; prefer cardinality=2 first
minimum_empirical_premises: Exact producer facts/query/predicate identities; exact same-unit respondent incidence or formally information-equivalent representation; exact risk-set; exact support n,d; exact response/routing state semantics
joint_information_requirement: REQUIRED and must be exact; marginals/source block membership/semantic adjacency are insufficient
core_falsifiers: No exact same-unit/equivalent carrier; any member identity mismatch; conjunction support not replayable; denominator/risk-set mismatch; nonpositive producer premise promoted; permission widened
information_loss: PREFER_NONE__REFERENCE_PRESERVING; keep exact member and incidence/query refs
replay_minimum: Canonical conjunction member identities/order policy + exact same-unit binding semantics + query/fact/support refs + risk-set + authorities + replay
avoided_authorities: No transport; no geometry; no PRA; no strong noun; no causal interpretation; no general discovery
conditional_recommendation: BEST_UNAMBIGUOUS_RELATIONAL_FALLBACK if A/B prove exact pair jointability cheaply

candidate_relation_semantics: Within one exact risk-set, target-state support is conditioned on an exact condition predicate; optional redistribution compares exact conditional support against an explicitly named lawful reference/baseline
order_cardinality: ROLE_ORDER_IS_SEMANTIC; cardinality=3 or 4 depending baseline; no metric geometry
minimum_empirical_premises: Exact same-unit condition+target incidence; exact condition denominator >0; target support; exact risk-set/routing; exact baseline/reference identity if redistribution rather than conditional support; measure/weight only if already authorized
core_falsifiers: Zero/missing condition denominator; no exact same-unit binding; undeclared baseline; baseline/comparison authority mismatch; support difference computed across incomparable scopes; upstream negative promoted; replay mismatch
information_loss: REFERENCE_PRESERVING preferred; any sufficient-statistic cache must retain denominator/baseline provenance
replay_minimum: Condition/target/risk-set/baseline refs + exact supports + routing/applicability refs + measure authority + canonical calculation/rule + replay
avoided_authorities: No pressure/mechanism meaning; no transport if single-context; no geometry; no actor meaning
conditional_recommendation: THIRD_CHOICE; strong descriptive value but more premises than R01/R02

candidate_relation_semantics: Two exact source-native states/relations are compared within one governed scope under an exact shared measure/comparability rule; may state greater/less/equal only at the authorized grain
order_cardinality: LEFT/RIGHT order is semantic; cardinality fixed at 2 compared objects plus scope/rule refs
minimum_empirical_premises: Exact comparable producer facts; shared or explicitly mapped measure basis; exact reference orientation; same scope/time unless separately authorized; exact uncertainty/materiality authority only if claimed
joint_information_requirement: PAIRWISE_INFORMATION may be sufficient; respondent-level joint incidence is required only if the comparison claim itself depends on paired same-unit data
core_falsifiers: No exact comparability/measure rule; left/right substitution; scale/order not source-authorized; comparison across mismatched scope/time; significance/materiality inferred without authority
replay_minimum: Both fact refs + comparison-rule authority + measure/scope/time refs + exact calculation + replay
avoided_authorities: No geometry; no cross-context transport if same context; no strong noun; no actor semantics
conditional_recommendation: USE_ONLY_IF_A/B candidate is inherently comparative and exact comparability is already free

candidate_relation_semantics: An exact finite set of mutually declared actor-independent alternatives/branches exists at a source-native structural-observatory grain; says only membership/alternatives, not choice, position or trajectory
order_cardinality: Canonical member identity order unless order separately semantic; finite cardinality exact
minimum_empirical_premises: Exact producer-owned branch/predicate identities and authority that they form the declared alternative set; exact scope/risk-set; completeness ceiling explicitly bounded
joint_information_requirement: NOT_NECESSARILY_JOINT unless branch semantics require same-unit exclusivity/exhaustiveness
core_falsifiers: Set completeness not authorized; members inferred by labels; branch membership semantics unavailable; exclusivity/exhaustiveness invented; replay mismatch
replay_minimum: Exact member refs + bounded frontier/completeness authority + scope + replay
avoided_authorities: No position/choice/trajectory; no geometry; no strong noun
conditional_recommendation: LOWER_PRIORITY because set-constitution/completeness authority may cost more than simple support

candidate_relation_semantics: A descriptive dependence between separately authorized position-role and disposition-role variables/states within one exact scope, without FIELD/HOMOLOGY/pressure/mechanism interpretation
order_cardinality: ROLE_ORDER_SEMANTIC; cardinality fixed pair plus scope
minimum_empirical_premises: Exact producer facts; exact POSITION_ROLE_AUTHORITY and disposition-role authority; exact same-unit or comparator semantics as required; exact transforms/measure/risk-set
core_falsifiers: Missing PRA/role authority; source variable treated as sociological role by convenience; transform/scale not authorized; dependence promoted to homology/field/mechanism; replay mismatch
information_loss: REFERENCE_PRESERVING with all role/transform authorities pinned
replay_minimum: Fact refs + PRA/role refs + exact incidence/support + scope + transforms + replay
avoided_authorities: Avoids strong nouns only if role authorities already exist; does not avoid PRA
conditional_recommendation: NOT_FIRST_THREAD_PREFERRED; activate only if fan-in shows the exact role authorities are already current and no cheaper relation is executable
